d:
Chinese satellites made unusual orbital manoeuvres to increase their coverage of Pahalgam, just days before the 22 April 2025 terror attack that killed 26 people. One satellite doubled the number of times it passed over the region six days before the attack. On the day of the killings, two other Chinese satellites also altered their orbits to make more frequent passes over Pahalgam.
These findings emerge from an analysis by Bengaluru-based space surveillance company Digantara, exclusively accessed by ThePrint.
